calibration.method: Resolved in-scope markets are split by whether they ever traded. Only traded markets carry a real last price, so only they are calibrated: each is bucketed by its last traded YES price and the bucket's mean price is compared with the share that resolved YES. Arithmetic only; no model is fitted.
